factual_profile.concise_summary: Ahrefs is an SEO research platform built around a large backlink index and keyword database, with Site Explorer, Content Explorer, Site Audit and Rank Tracker.
factual_profile.primary_purpose: Backlink research, keyword analysis and competitor SEO intelligence.
limitations: Higher price point than some competitors.
Focused on SEO; does not cover broader marketing workflows.

best_for: Link building and link-gap analysis across competitors.
Content strategy: finding topics, formats and pages that earn search traffic.
SEO specialists who need backlink data as a primary workflow.
not_recommended_for: Buyers who need only occasional keyword ideas without backlink analysis.
Small sites that will not use the full Site Explorer or audit features.
Teams that need broader marketing tools beyond SEO.
editorial.editorial_summary: A strong candidate when backlink research and keyword data depth justify the cost; a poor value when the need is only occasional lookups or a single audit.

pricing.billingCaveat: Annual billing saves up to 17 percent. Ahrefs states it never runs discounts. Extra users and credit top-ups are charged automatically when you exceed limits. Regional pricing and taxes vary.

overview.tagline: SEO research platform built around backlink data and keyword analysis
overview.description: Ahrefs is an SEO platform known for its comprehensive backlink index and keyword database. It offers Site Explorer for backlink research, Content Explorer for content analysis, Site Audit for technical SEO, and Rank Tracker for position monitoring.

features.name: Site Explorer
features.description: Backlink analysis with the industry's freshest link index. Analyze any domain's backlink profile, find linking pages, and track new and lost links.

features.name: Keywords Explorer
features.description: Keyword research with search volume, difficulty score, click metrics, and SERP overview. Generate keyword ideas and analyze competitor keywords.

features.name: Content Explorer
features.description: Content research tool to find top-performing content, analyze what earns links and shares, and identify content gaps.

features.name: Site Audit
features.description: Technical SEO crawler that identifies crawlability issues, broken links, duplicate content, and on-page SEO problems with prioritized fixes.

features.name: Rank Tracker
features.description: Weekly keyword position tracking with ranking history, keyword grouping, and SERP feature tracking.

features.name: Alerts
features.description: Monitor competitor backlinks, keyword rankings, and new content with customizable alerts.

features.name: API and MCP access
features.description: Programmatic access to Ahrefs data starting from Lite plan. Minimum 50 units per API request.

faqs.a: Ahrefs pricing starts at $29 per month for Starter, $129 for Lite ($108 billed annually), $249 for Standard ($208 annually), and $449 for Advanced ($374 annually). Enterprise starts at $1,499 per month with annual commitment.

faqs.q: Does Ahrefs have a free plan?
faqs.a: Ahrefs Free provides limited Site Explorer and Site Audit access for sites you own. The Starter plan at $29 per month offers 200 credits for keyword research.

faqs.q: Does Ahrefs offer a free trial?
faqs.a: No free trial. Ahrefs offers a 7-day money-back guarantee on annual plans. Monthly plans have no refund option.

faqs.q: What is the difference between Ahrefs Lite and Standard?
faqs.a: Lite costs $129 per month with 1,000 credits, 6 months of historical data, and 2,500 report rows. Standard costs $249 with unlimited credits, 2 years of history, and 30,000 report rows.

faqs.q: How many users are included in Ahrefs?
faqs.a: Every plan includes one user. Extra users cost $40 per month on Lite (up to 2), $60 on Standard (up to 5), $80 on Advanced (up to 10), and $100 on Enterprise.

Ahrefs excels at backlink analysis with a fresher index. Semrush offers broader marketing features including PPC and social media. Choose Ahrefs for link-building focus; choose Semrush for broader marketing needs.
